missing_spec_content.spec_text: investigate the effectiveness of different materials as thermal insulators and the factors that may affect the thermal insulation properties of a material.
missing_spec_content.why: The lesson covers only the first half of the practical: 'The independent variable is the material' (keyPoints[3].content). It never sets up an investigation of a factor that affects insulation properties, such as thickness or number of layers. Thickness appears only as a control variable.

missing_spec_content.spec_text: Investigate thermal conductivity using rods of different materials.
missing_spec_content.why: The lesson does not mention comparing thermal conductivity using rods of different materials.

factual_errors.text: electrical resistance in wires: electrical energy → thermal energy. This is how a kettle heats water.
factual_errors.correction: This is listed as an example of dissipation, but heating the water is the useful transfer in a kettle. Only the energy that heats the kettle body and the air is dissipated. Checkpoint 1 and the tables row say exactly this, so the lesson contradicts itself. Also, 'electrical energy' is not an energy store. Energy is transferred electrically.

factual_errors.text: "Incandescent light bulb", "Electrical" (under the header "Input energy store"); likewise "Electric motor", "Electrical" and "Electric kettle", "Electrical"
factual_errors.correction: 'Electrical' is a transfer pathway (energy transferred electrically), not an energy store. Labelling it as an input store mixes up stores and transfers. The lesson itself warns against this in commonMistakes[1].

factual_errors.text: Using oil or similar material between surfaces to reduce friction and heat loss
factual_errors.correction: Lubrication reduces friction, so less energy is dissipated by heating the moving parts. 'Heat loss' is the language of thermal insulation and does not describe what lubrication does.

wrong_terms.text: Shaping an object to reduce air resistance and the kinetic energy lost to drag

not_checked: All keyPoints have "diagram": null, so there were no diagrams or images to check.
